root_cause: PG-specific UUID dialect type is not compatible with SQLite used in test suite
lesson: Always use sqlalchemy.types.Uuid in models, never the PG dialect variant

incident: settings singleton could not be overridden in tests
root_cause: settings is instantiated at module import time; env var overrides after first import have no effect
fix: Tests use fixture-level env setup before any import of settings
lesson: settings is import-time singleton — test env must be set before the module is first imported
